name: technology-intelligence
description: Evidence-backed technology decisions compare frameworks, platforms, infrastructure, and CLI/MCP/API delivery modes with dated primary-source observations, explicit gaps, staleness checks, and review-gated refreshes.

interface.shortDescription: Dated evidence for contextual technology choices.
interface.longDescription: Compare software frameworks, platforms, data and infrastructure technologies, and agent delivery modes through dated primary-source observations, explicit decision profiles, hard gates, alternatives, confidence, and visible evidence gaps. A separate maintenance workflow validates staleness, reviews source and licensing constraints, captures allowlisted refresh receipts outside tracked source, and proposes reviewable dataset changes without automatically changing recommendations or owning runtime installation and invocation.
capabilities: Experiment, startup, scale-up, and enterprise-critical decision profiles
Frontend, backend, data, infrastructure, CLI, MCP, API, SDK, and Agent Skills candidates
First-party evidence and independent-signal coverage gates
Explicit unknown, licensing, maturity, maintenance, security, and operational-load gaps
Deterministic offline validation, query, staleness, diff, and trigger-contract checks
Explicit allowlisted source capture with immutable receipts and no recommendation mutation
Read-only joins to caller-supplied runtime capability inventories
defaultPrompt: Compare current technology options for this project and recommend a context-appropriate shortlist with dated evidence and explicit gaps.
Audit and refresh the Technology Intelligence evidence snapshot without automatically changing its assessments.
